section 1 of Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965  
as amended, is further amended by adding thereto the following: ’
(7) Director, Office of Foreign Direct Investments, Department of

notes: Order is one amendment instruction adding an item to EO 11248 sec. 1.

By virtue of the authority vested in 
me as President of the United States, I 
hereby extend the existence of the Que- 
tico-Superior Committee, created by Ex­
ecutive Order No. 6783 of June 30, 1934, 
for a period of four years, from June 30, 
1938 to June 30, 1942.

notes: One-paragraph order; whole text is one operative clause.
